capabilities: Sync contacts from Microsoft 365 and Google
Import contacts from CSV and vCard files
Create minimal person notes on first mention
extras: Google sign-in works on desktop only; a Google OAuth app left in Testing mode forces a new sign-in every 7 days. Client secrets and sessions are kept in Obsidian's secret storage, outside the vault, and access is read-only.
problem: Obsidian has no way to autocomplete people from an address book, so mentioning someone means typing the full name and creating a person note by hand.

relations.evidence: signs in to Microsoft the same way as the Outlook Calendar Panel and Microsoft To Do Panel plugins

Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Syncs contacts from Microsoft 365 or Google (or imports CSV/vCard) and autocompletes them as person links, creating a minimal note on first mention.
